subject: x axis values not in increasing order

messages.author: bb863f2ab544db4d
messages.subject: x axis values not in increasing order
parts:
Hi ggplot users,

I created a pdf of a bar graph with the following code but the values for the x-axis are not ordered:

pdf("Overall_TripLength_personal.pdf", onefile = TRUE, width = 11, height = 8.5)
options(scipen = 3)
g.wkend <- ggplot(wkend_personaltravel, aes(x=TOD, y=ODFreq)) + geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "red") + scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) + xlab("Trip Duration (Hours)") + ylab("Number of Trips") + ggtitle("Overall Trip Length Distribution - Weekend")
grid.arrange(g.wkend)
dev.off()

Below is the graph the code produces:



I thought the values will number from 1 to 24 in increasing order.

Thanks for your help.

Leslie.

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: x axis values not in increasing order
parts:
Your time is being converted to character and then factor and is in "alphabetical" order. 

You should set the levels of your time element like so before your plot code.

wkend_personaltravel$TOD <- factor(as.character(TOD), levels= 1:24)
